title: Bikin Hati Tenang, Servis Berkala Mobil Hybrid di Bengkel Resmi Toyota Banyak Untungnya
observation: Toyota explicitly represents its xEV periodic-service intervals as the same. The FAQ describes a first service within one month and subsequent first-to-seventh services within six-month timing conditions.
limitation: Generic hybrid/xEV article, not an inspected model/year maintenance manual, actual visit history or equivalent work quantity. Does not establish that HEV and BEV jobs, parts, costs, payer or contribution are identical.
claim_implication: Friend nuance about intervals versus work quantity is supported at published-representation level; fewer BEV engine-related jobs cannot alone prove fewer scheduled dealer visits.

observation: Toyota describes the service adviser providing a parts/labor estimate and obtaining customer agreement before repair.
limitation: No actual invoice, authorization or branch execution observed. This is an existing promised process, not proof that every current quote is transparent or every charge authorized.
claim_implication: R1/R2 price-clarity ideas must compare with an already represented estimate/approval process rather than assume none exists.
